title: flipscores
text: package provides functions hypothesis tests GLMs based sign-flipping score contributions. tests robust overdispersion, heteroscedasticity , cases, ignored nuisance variables. vignette, provide use cases simulation study show possible usage package. flipscores function main function package. supports standard usage R modeling functions, glm, inherits majority arguments. Functions like summary anova can applied flipscores objects, obtaining output usual format. p-values obtained randomly sign-flipping score contributions comparing observed score flipped scores. Equivalently, one might apply flipscores function precomputed glm model. Notice p-values identical ones previous model. fact, computing possible combinations flipped score contributions computationally unfeasible. subset possibilities computed, regulated parameter n_flips, default 5000. Reproducibility can achieved setting argument seed precomputing flips function make_flips. One-sided testing alternatives also covered subset parameters interest, to_be_tested parameter can set avoid computing p-values others to_be_tested accepts vectors name variables indexing numbers; indicators refer name cardinality variable summary output, Intercept always correspond number 1, particular attention paid factor/character variables involved. flipscores supports available families glm, also Negative Binomial family. , particular, indicated "negbinom" quotes. confint method also applicable provide confidence intervals based inversion sign-flip score tests. intervals inherit properties robustness variance misspecification test. , various options allowed, including possibility generate symmetric confidence intervals.
